positive_snippets: I stayed here for 2 days while attending an event at Yashobhoomi and had a really comfortable experience. The staff were very cooperative and went out of their way to help. They even cooked food for my 1 year old baby exactly as per my requirements, which meant a lot to me. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and the overall hospitality was excellent. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a pleasant and supportive stay!

Very comfortable stay. The best perk of staying at this hotel is Yashobhoomi exhibition centre is just five minutes drive. No traffic,   rooms, satff,  food. Everything is very good and very comfortable.
